coordinate_convention.normalized: x: 0 left -> 1 right; y: 0 top -> 1 bottom
coordinate_convention.note: T015 centers are catalog seeds from visual measurement of the exact target. ROI/anchor/depth-intent refinement is explicitly deferred to T016; Gate measurement is deferred to T021.

priority_semantics.P0: Whitebox composition skeleton. These landmarks drive camera/composition and later inherit the spec's P0 center tolerance and occlusion-order requirements.
priority_semantics.P1: Major secondary world geometry/depth relationships used to validate 3D structure and framing.
priority_semantics.P2: Decorative or screen-space landmarks that support final visual/readability matching and must not override P0/P1 composition.

measurement_method.precision_note: Catalog centers are intentionally coarse seeds, not final Gate measurements. T016/T021 must refine and verify.
